description: Mobile post-cart and account flows plus docs: addresses (select mode), checkout with persisted idempotency key + fingerprint, COD and mock polling, isolated Razorpay adapter STUB (not shipped working), order confirmation; orders list/detail with shared tracking/GST helpers, cancel and return flows with required photos (expo-image-picker + manipulator + upload); notifications, help/CMS, account/profile, DPDP export + account deletion, push stub; apps/mobile/README.md (design §6.6-6.9, §11, §14; plan.md items 21-24). Depends on FEAT-004 (cart, auth) and FEAT-003.
steps: plan.md item 21: features/addresses/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/{AddressesScreen,AddressFormScreen}.tsx} (addressInputSchema form, GST_STATES picker, resolve-pincode autofill on 6 valid digits, serviceability badge, default via PUT ?default=true with full body, delete with ConfirmDialog, select mode using navigation.popTo('Checkout', { addressId }, { merge: true }) on card tap and after create). features/checkout/{api.ts,hooks.ts,checkout-attempt.ts,checkout-selection.ts,payment-outcome.ts,order-result.ts,screens/{CheckoutScreen,OrderConfirmationScreen}.tsx} exactly per §6.6/§6.8/§11 (selectCheckoutAddress, availableMethods(codEnabled, extra.onlinePaymentEnabled), preview with paymentMethod for the COD fee, sha256 fingerprint via expo-crypto, belzo.checkout.attempt in AsyncStorage with 30 min TTL, definitive vs ambiguous classification, place timeout 30 s, usePreventRemove while placing, invalidateQueries(qk.cart('customer')) + qk.orders, clear couponCode, reset to [Main, OrderConfirmation]; handlePaymentOutcome issues exactly one cancel for 'unavailable'; resolveOrderResultView parity with apps/web/src/app/(shop)/order-result/page.tsx resolveView, 2.5 s polling up to 12). features/payments/{adapter.ts,mock-adapter.ts,razorpay-adapter.stub.ts,registry.ts} (stub isAvailable() false, pay() → unavailable, TODO(Phase 5) comment; do NOT install react-native-razorpay). Tests features/checkout/__tests__/{checkout-attempt,payment-outcome,checkout-selection,order-result}.test.ts. Commit `feat(mobile): addresses, checkout with idempotent place, COD/mock payment and order confirmation`.

plan.md item 22: features/orders/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/{OrdersScreen,OrderDetailScreen,CancelOrderScreen,ReturnRequestScreen}.tsx,components/{TrackingTimeline,PriceBreakupRows,ReturnPhotoPicker}.tsx} using shared shortOrderId, statusBadge, formatDate, formatInr, buildStepper, paymentSummary, breakupView, gstNote, cancelEligibility, cancelUnavailableReason, CANCEL_REASONS, cancelReasonError, cancelReasonText, refundNote, commentMaxChars, returnEligibility, RETURN_REASONS, resolutionOptions, photosRequired, returnStepError, RETURN_STEPS, buildReturnPayload, returnStatusLabel/Tone, resolutionLabel, variantText, isLiveStatus. OrderDetail polls 30 s while live and focused; invoice via WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync; copy id via expo-clipboard; reorder sets the cart cache. ReturnPhotoPicker: expo-image-picker camera/library (mediaTypes ['images']), expo-image-manipulator resize ≤1600 px JPEG 0.8, uploadImage('/orders/returns/media/upload'), ≤MAX_RETURN_IMAGES, per-tile error with Retry/Remove, camera denial → Linking.openSettings(). usePreventRemove on dirty drafts. Add a unit test for the photo normalise/upload helper or ReturnPhotoPicker (mocks). Commit `feat(mobile): orders, tracking, cancel and return requests with photos`.

plan.md item 23: features/notifications/{api.ts,hooks.ts,push.ts,screens/NotificationsScreen.tsx} (mark read on focus, ≤100 ids; push.ts stub returns {status:'unsupported'} with TODO(Phase 7); no expo-notifications), features/support/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/{HelpScreen,CmsPageScreen}.tsx}, features/profile/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/{AccountScreen,ProfileEditScreen}.tsx} (guest vs customer menus; profilePatchSchema; changed fields only; 409 → field by message substring), features/privacy/{api.ts,hooks.ts,export-decode.ts,screens/{PrivacyDataScreen,DataExportViewScreen}.tsx} (export + requests polling 5 s while pending/processing and focused; decodeExport per §11; deletion ConfirmDialog requiring typed DELETE → POST deletion → tokenManager.logout() → 'Deletion requested'). Test features/privacy/__tests__/export-decode.test.ts. Delete src/navigation/PlaceholderScreen.tsx so typecheck proves no route still uses it. Commit `feat(mobile): notifications, help and CMS pages, profile, DPDP export and account deletion`.

plan.md item 24: write apps/mobile/README.md (setup, variants/schemes, EXPO_PUBLIC_* flags, EAS profiles and commands requiring the owner's Expo account and `eas init`, LIVE-store warning for dev/preview builds, deploy order: backend A1/A7/A8 before any mobile build, dev-client cleartext/LAN gotcha, placeholder icon/splash and owner must supply the official master logo, shared must stay Node/DOM-free, any fallback pinned dependency recorded by FEAT-003 findings, refresh-token kill race note, push + Razorpay out of scope, HTTPS owner task, no APK built in this run). Verify with `pnpm exec prettier --check apps/mobile/README.md`. Commit `docs(mobile): README with variants, EAS, owner TODOs and live-store warning`.
